issues.title: Closed, solid mesh
issues.message: The model has 0 open edges and 2 non-manifold edges, so it is not a sealed solid. The slicer may fill it wrongly or skip parts of it.
issues.suggestion: Close the holes in your CAD tool or run a repair (e.g. Windows 3D Builder, PrusaSlicer 'Repair', or Meshmixer 'Make Solid') and re-export.

issues.title: 1 mm bottom chamfer
issues.message: Recommend adding 1mm chamfer to the base of all parts for maximum reliability and highest tolerance.

issues.title: Minimum thickness 0.5 mm
issues.message: Thinnest wall is 0.05 mm (limit 0.50 mm), across about 89.5 mm² of the part. Walls this thin may print with gaps or not at all.
issues.suggestion: Thicken thin walls, fins and plates to at least 0.5 mm — 1.2 mm or more for strength.

issues.title: Potential Excessive Support
issues.message: Estimated support is about 128% of the part's volume (53.3 cm³ of support for 41.6 cm³ of part). Highlighted areas overhang 35° or less from horizontal.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part to reduce overhangs, add chamfers under overhangs, or split it into pieces that print flat.

issues.title: Requires Support
issues.message: About 10521 mm² of overhangs (35° or less from horizontal) will need support. Highlighted areas show where.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so fewer surfaces face downward, or add chamfers under overhangs.

issues.title: Flat on the bed
issues.message: Only 3.1 mm² of the bottom sits flat on the bed (needs about 50.0 mm²). The part may come loose during printing.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so its largest flat face is on the bottom, or add a flat base before exporting.

issues.title: Minimum thickness 0.5 mm

issues.title: No thin vertical stalks
issues.message: A column about 1.7 mm wide and 9.0 mm tall (5.4× taller than wide) may wobble while printing and snap off during handling.
issues.suggestion: Thicken the column to at least 2 mm, add a fillet or brace at its base, or print it lying down.
